description: An application submitted under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for a minor material amendment in connection with the planning permission ref. 22/3782/MA dated 17 March 2023 to vary Condition 2; Condition 14; Condition 16; Condition 18; Condition 26; Condition 27; Condition 28 and Condition 62 to allow for the following:- Amendment to unit numbers to increase the number of homes provided in Plot 1;- Amendments to housing mix;- Amendments to design codes and to the approved ground floor and proposed vertical limits of deviation from AOD parameter plans- Amendments to play provision.ÿ(This application is an EIA development and is accompanied by an Environmental Compliance Report Addendum)
